function.name: us_history_events_by_presidency
function.description: Retrieve the major events during the presidency of a specified US president. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

president_name.description: The name of the US president.

start_year.description: The start year of their presidency (optional).

end_year.description: The end year of their presidency (optional).

We need to call this twice? Or maybe we can combine into one request with multiple presidents? But the function signature expects single president_name; so likely separate calls per president. We'll produce two responses or combine them after retrieving data from each call.

We'll use the function once for "Abraham Lincoln" and then again for "George Washington". Provide start_year and end_year if needed but defaults fine.

Let's do first call:
